data.gender_notes: Marla is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Marla is derived from the Latin word 'Marlis' which means 'little one' or 'rebel'. This name is a combination of the words 'Mara' meaning 'bitter' and 'Lael' meaning 'lion'. The name Marla represents a gentle yet strong and rebellious spirit. The name Marla carries the meaning “Gentle Rebel” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Marla usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle rebel and live with faith, good character and purpose.
